task.text:
Compose an appropriate apology for the following situation. Output the apology.

You accidentally posted a rude comment about someone on a public forum.

attempts.high: I accidentally posted a rude comment about someone on a public forum and I need to apologize. Write the apology however you think works best — you decide the tone, the angle, what to acknowledge, how to frame it. Take whatever creative approach feels right to make it land. Just give me the apology.
attempts.low: I accidentally posted a rude comment about someone on a public forum. Write an apology using exactly this structure: sentence 1 names what I did, sentence 2 says it was wrong, sentence 3 says sorry to the person, sentence 4 says it won't happen again. One sentence each, no extra lines, no embellishment. Just give me the apology.
